variables:

  tags:
  - api
  - demo
operations:
- operationId: list_pets
  sourceDescription: petstore_api

    query:
      limit: 10
      status: available
  successCriteria:

    body:
      name: Buddy
      tag: dog
  successCriteria:
  - condition: $response.statusCode == 201
  onSuccess:
  - name: goto_validate
    type: goto
    workflowId: parallel_checks
  onFailure:
  - name: end_on_error
    type: end

- workflowId: parallel_checks

  description: Run validation after pet creation
